name: MonarchLeaderboard
title: Leaderboard
wrapsNative: VStack of rows (HStack of Text, MonarchAvatar, ProgressView with .progressViewStyle(.monarchLinear) and MonarchDeltaIndicator); Button for tappable rows; MonarchEmptyState and MonarchInlineErrorRetry for the states; .redacted(reason: .placeholder) while loading
summary: A ranked list for dashboards: rank, avatar, name, value, an optional change and a bar relative to the leader, with ties sharing a rank and the viewer's own row tagged.
whenToUse: On a dashboard that compares a few people, teams or things by one figure (tickets solved per agent, reply rate per campaign step), especially when viewers want to see where they stand.
whenNotToUse: For many columns per entry, use MonarchDataTable. For a share of a whole or plain ranked bars without people, use MonarchBarList. For figures without a ranking, use MonarchMetric.
api: init(_ entries: [MonarchLeaderboardEntry], label: String? = nil, valueLabel: String? = nil, sort: MonarchBarListSort = .none, format: MonarchMetricFormat = .number, isCompact: Bool = false, changeComparison: String? = nil, changeGoodDirection: MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection = .up, showsAvatars: Bool = true, showsBars: Bool = true, highlightsTop: Bool = false, limit: Int? = nil, total: Int? = nil, isLoading: Bool = false, loadingRows: Int = 5, errorMessage: String? = nil, isRetrying: Bool = false, labels: MonarchLeaderboardLabels = MonarchLeaderboardLabels(), onShowMore: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onSelect: (@MainActor (MonarchLeaderboardEntry) -> Void)? = nil, onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)

MonarchLeaderboardEntry.init(_ name: String, value: Double, id: String? = nil, display: String? = nil, secondary: String? = nil, avatarURL: URL? = nil, seed: String? = nil, avatarShape: MonarchAvatarShape = .circle, change: Double? = nil, badge: String? = nil, badgeTone: MonarchTone = .neutral, isCurrent: Bool = false)
struct MonarchLeaderboardLabels { var you, empty, loading, retry: String?; var more, rank: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? }

options.name: entries
options.description: The entries, best first, or in any order with sort.

options.name: label
options.description: Names the ranking for VoiceOver, such as "Tickets solved this month".

options.name: valueLabel
options.description: What the value counts, read after it, such as "open tickets".

options.name: sort
options.description: The shared sort of ranked lists: .descending ranks the largest first, .ascending the smallest (response times), .none keeps the given order.

options.name: format
options.description: How a value without display is written: a number, a percentage of a ratio, or a currency amount.

options.name: isCompact
options.description: Writes values short, such as 1.2K.

options.name: changeComparison
options.description: The comparison period read after each change, such as "vs last month".

options.name: changeGoodDirection
options.description: Which direction of change is an improvement; .down for response times.

options.name: showsAvatars
options.description: Whether each row shows an avatar.

options.name: showsBars
options.description: Whether each row shows a bar relative to the largest value shown.

options.name: highlightsTop
options.description: Whether the top three ranks get a filled marker.

options.name: limit
options.description: Shows at most this many rows; the rest are counted in "N more".

options.name: total
options.description: How many entries exist when entries is already a top N.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: Shows placeholder rows.

options.name: loadingRows
options.description: How many placeholder rows.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: Replaces the rows with this failure.

options.name: isRetrying
options.description: Whether the retry is running; the retry button shows progress.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: With errorMessage, adds a retry button.

options.name: onShowMore
options.description: Makes "N more" a button that opens the full ranking; without it the line is text.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Makes each row a button that opens the entry.

states.name: ready
states.description: Ranked rows; equal values share a rank.

states.name: current
states.description: The viewer's row is tinted with the accent subtle background, outlined with the accent border and tagged "(you)".

states.name: top three
states.description: With highlightsTop, ranks 1 to 3 sit on a filled accent circle.

states.name: loading
states.description: Redacted placeholder rows, read as "Loading ranking".

states.name: empty
states.description: A small MonarchEmptyState, "Nothing to rank yet".

states.name: failed
states.description: The message with a Retry button when onRetry is given, or the message with a warning icon in the danger role.

appearance: Names and values are in the default text role, ranks, secondary lines and the "(you)" tag in the muted role. Bars are the Monarch linear progress style: the accent solid fill on the muted background. The current row uses the accent subtle background and the accent border. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes come from these roles.
platformNotes: The web bars use the first data colour; iOS reuses the Monarch linear progress style, whose fill is the accent role. The web names become links with href and "N more" links to moreHref; on iOS rows and "N more" are buttons whose actions the app uses to navigate. The web secondary line and badge take any content; on iOS they are strings, the badge drawn as a MonarchBadge. The web change takes any DeltaIndicator props; on iOS each entry has a ratio, and the comparison and good direction are set once for the board. The web's sort, format and notation map to the shared MonarchBarListSort, MonarchMetricFormat and isCompact. There is no ordered-list role on iOS, so each row speaks its rank. At the accessibility text sizes the value and change move under the name and the avatar is dropped, so the name keeps its width. Android uses the same name and options. Several closures are optional (onShowMore, onSelect, onRetry). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is onShowMore.
accessibility: Each row is one element read as "Rank 1: Ana Lima, (you), 3 breached, Tier 2, 42 tickets solved, up 12%, better".
Avatars and bars are hidden; the name and the number with its unit carry the data.
The viewer's row is marked in words, not only by its tint.
With onSelect each row is a button with a 44-point touch target.
The placeholder rows are one element named "Loading ranking".
The board is a container named by label.
edgeCases: Equal values share a rank and the next rank skips: 1, 1, 3.
Bars are relative to the largest magnitude shown, so a negative value draws a bar of its size; all zero draws empty bars.
limit 0 or a negative limit shows every row.
A total smaller than the rows shown adds no "N more".
Long names wrap; the value column keeps its width.

examples.title: Agents by tickets solved
examples.template:
MonarchLeaderboard(
    [
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry({{entries.0.name}}, value: {{entries.0.value}}, id: {{entries.0.id}}, change: {{entries.0.change}}),
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry({{entries.1.name}}, value: {{entries.1.value}}, id: {{entries.1.id}}, change: {{entries.1.change}}, badge: {{entries.1.badge}}, badgeTone: {{entries.1.badgeTone|tone}}),
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry({{entries.2.name}}, value: {{entries.2.value}}, id: {{entries.2.id}}, isCurrent: {{entries.2.current}}),
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry({{entries.3.name}}, value: {{entries.3.value}}, id: {{entries.3.id}}, secondary: {{entries.3.secondary}}),
    ],
    label: {{label}},
    valueLabel: {{valueLabel}},
    sort: .descending,
    highlightsTop: true,
    limit: {{limit}},
    total: {{total}},
    onShowMore: {}
)
examples.code:
MonarchLeaderboard(
    [
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry("Ada Moss", value: 64, id: "a", change: 0.12),
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry("Bea Lund", value: 51, id: "b", change: -0.04, badge: "2 breached", badgeTone: .danger),
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry("Cal Ortiz", value: 51, id: "c", isCurrent: true),
        MonarchLeaderboardEntry("Dee Park", value: 38, id: "d", secondary: "Billing team"),
    ],
    label: "Tickets solved this month",
    valueLabel: "tickets solved",
    sort: .descending,
    highlightsTop: true,
    limit: 4,
    total: 9,
    onShowMore: {}
)
